overall_assessment: All eight random controls were read in full; the packet contains no suspects and the pre-pass flags no offerings. No personal data leaks or inappropriate removal of substantive course content were found, and exam-date blocks were correctly removed. However, yearless administrative withdrawal deadlines survive in all eight courses, and removing a semester-year phrase corrupts one assessment sentence and obscures its temporal scope.

findings.description: All eight courses retain administrative withdrawal deadlines such as 1. mai and 1. november, including combined alternatives. These are administrative dates under the rubric even without a year. The zero admin_date flags therefore miss a recurring problem outside the removed exam-date blocks.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_mf() removes the Eksamensdatoer block, but does not handle withdrawal dates embedded in study-requirement prose. The generic date rules do not remove these standalone yearless day-and-month deadlines.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_mf(), match yearless Norwegian day-and-month dates, including slash-separated alternatives, specifically in clauses about withdrawing an exam registration or a trekkfrist. Replace the deadline phrase with a neutral phrase such as innen gjeldende trekkfrist, preserving the surrounding requirement and avoiding blanket removal of content dates.

findings.evidence: har SAM2080L skriftlig skoleeksamen (6 timer) som vurderingsform.
findings.description: Removing Vårsemesteret 2026 leaves the assessment sentence starting with har SAM2080L and no grammatical opening. The following I andre semestre gjelder denne informasjonen introduces a different oral assessment, so stripping the opening also obscures that the written examination is a semester-specific exception. This is damaged course prose, rather than a harmless dangling administrative label; no pre-pass flag detects it.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The season-plus-year removal in .anon_generic() deletes the entire sentence-initial Vårsemesteret 2026 phrase without repairing the clause or preserving its role in distinguishing the two assessment variants.
findings.suggested_fix: Before generic date removal, add a scoped .anon_mf() replacement for a sentence-initial semester-year phrase followed by har and the course code: replace the dated phrase with I ett semester. This removes the administrative dating while retaining grammatical prose and its relationship to I andre semestre.
